title: Figure 8: The Michigan Electrodes - silicon probes on a U.S. penny and 3D probe array
description: Two photographs: on the left, various silicon neural probes placed on the back of a U.S. penny with the Lincoln Memorial columns visible; on the right, four 64-site probes assembled into a three-dimensional comb-like structure. The caption reads "Figure 8. The Michigan Electrodes" (Reference 49). Surrounding text discusses new electrode designs compatible with MRI.
